intro: One of the world's most exciting cuisines: Andean potatoes and chillies meet Japanese (Nikkei) and Chinese (Chifa) influences.
flavours: Ají amarillo, lime, potatoes, corn, coriander, red onion
hk: Peruvian and Nikkei restaurants are a fixture of Hong Kong's dining scene.

dishes.name: Ceviche
dishes.what: Raw fish 'cooked' in lime juice with chilli and red onion; the marinade is called leche de tigre.

dishes.name: Lomo saltado
dishes.what: Chinese-Peruvian stir-fry of beef, onions and tomatoes with soy, served with fries and rice.

dishes.name: Ají de gallina
dishes.what: Shredded chicken in a creamy yellow chilli and walnut sauce.

dishes.name: Anticuchos
dishes.what: Street skewers of marinated beef heart grilled over charcoal.

dishes.name: Causa limeña
dishes.what: Chilled layers of yellow-chilli mashed potato filled with chicken or tuna.

dishes.name: Pisco sour
dishes.what: Peru's national cocktail of pisco brandy, lime, sugar and frothy egg white.
